title: 雄猫道具与商店线（道具说明）（第 4／4 部分）

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [LOOKS LIKE YOU FINALLY GOT YOUR COSMOSUIT BACK ON]
rows.current: Tomcat: [过了这么久，看起来你终于把宇宙服穿回去了！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AFTER ALL THIS TIME!]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [THAT'S THE DANGER OF TAKING THE THING OFF...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [把这东西脱下来就是这风险……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AND ONCE YOU PAIR UP THE SUIT WITH THE COSMO HELM]
rows.current: Tomcat: [等你把这套衣服和宇宙盔配成对，你就能在任何大气里呼吸了！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YOU'LL BE ABLE TO BREATHE IN ANY SORT OF ATMOSPHERE!]
[HEEEEY WE'VE GOT COSMOCARDS ON THIS PLANET!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [嘿————这颗星球上有宇宙卡！]

rows.source: [OH NEAT! THOSE ARE GREAT FOR SOME FAUNA INFO]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哦，不错！那些对了解生物很有用]

rows.source: [THEY'LL LET YOU LEARN A BIT MORE ABOUT CREATURES]
rows.current: Tomcat: [它们能让你更了解这些生物，]

rows.source: [WHILE ALSO LETTING YOU KNOW IF THEY DROP ANY LOOT!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [也能告诉你它们会不会掉落战利品！]

rows.source: [AWWW, IS THAT A LEASH THAT YOU JUST PICKED UP THERE?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哎哟，你刚捡到的是条牵引绳吗？]

rows.source: [I DIDN'T KNOW YOU STILL NEEDED ONE OF THOSE!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [我不知道你还需要这个！]

rows.source: [H-HEY!! I REALLY REALLY DON'T!! IT'S JUST...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [喂、喂！！我真的真的不需要！！只是……]

rows.source: [...IT'S JUST A COMFORT THING, THAT'S ALL!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [……只是穿着舒服，就这样！]

rows.source: [IT SHOULD AT LEAST PROVIDE YOU WITH A BIT OF PROTECTION]
rows.current: Tomcat: [只要装备上，它至少能给你提供一点防护。在P.A.W.菜单里操作！]

rows.source: [IF YOU EQUIP IT. YOU CAN DO SO FROM YOUR P.A.W. MENU!]
[AWWW, IS THAT A LEASH THAT YOU JUST PICKED UP THERE?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哎呀，你刚捡到的是牵引绳吗？]

rows.source: [I DIDN'T KNOW YOU STILL NEEDED ONE OF THOSE!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [我不知道你还需要这个！]

rows.source: [HEY, A LIL BIT OF NOSTALGIA NEVER HURT ANYONE, RIGHT?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [嘿，偶尔怀旧一下又没什么坏处，对吧？]

rows.source: [WOW, SHAMELESS AREN'TYA GIRL? YOU'D NEVER CATCH ME DO-]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哇，不害臊是吧，姑娘？你绝对见不到我去-]

rows.source: [YOU'RE GONNA TELL ME YOU STILL DON'T DIP INTO SOFT FOOD]
rows.current: Yiffany: [你敢说你现在就不偶尔吃点软食？]

rows.source: [EVERY NOW AND AGAIN?]
[HEY, L-LOOK, THAT'S... THAT'S COMPLETELY...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [嘿，听、听着，那是……那完全是……]

rows.source: [I'VE GOT R-R-REPORTS TO DO, B-BYE!!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [我还有报、报告要做，再、再见！！]

rows.source: [HEE!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [嘻！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT SURE IS A CUTE LITTLE DRESS YOU'VE GOT THERE.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你这身小裙子确实挺可爱。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [HYPOTHETICALLY, IF YOU WERE TO KEEP IT AFTER...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [假设啊，要是你之后还留着它……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [HYPOTHETICALLY I'M GONNA *BITE* YOU, TOMCAT.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [假设啊，我要*咬*你，雄猫。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [I WILL UTILIZE THIS GARMENT'S WEIGHTLESS ABILITY TO]
rows.current: Yiffany: [为了任务，我会利用这件衣服的轻盈效果，穿过易塌的地段。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [TRAVERSE CRUMBLING TERRAIN FOR SAKE OF THE MISSION.]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT SURE IS A CUTE LITTLE DRESS YOU'VE GOT THERE.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你身上这条小裙子真可爱。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [IT'S... IT'S IMPORTANT FOR THE MISSION, OKAY!!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [这……这对任务很重要，好吗！！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [UH-HUH. YOU CAN STAND ON CRUMBLING TERRAIN FOR AS LONG]
rows.current: Tomcat: [嗯哼。你就能站在快塌的地面上，爱站多久站多久，而且还很性感！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AS YOU WANT, AND LOOK SEXY DOING IT!]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [LOOK S-S... WHAT?! YOU KNOW WHAT, YIFFAI OUT!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [看着性、性感……什么？！算了，伊吠通话完毕！]

rows.source: [THAT SURE IS A CUTE LITTLE DRESS YOU'VE GOT THERE.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你身上这条小裙子真可爱。]

rows.source: [IT'S... IT'S IMPORTANT FOR THE MISSION, OKAY!!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [这……这对任务很重要，好吗！！]

rows.source: [UH-HUH. YOU CAN STAND ON CRUMBLING TERRAIN FOR AS LONG]
rows.current: Tomcat: [嗯哼。你能一直站在会坍塌的地面上，]

rows.source: [AS YOU WANT, AND LOOK CUTE DOING IT!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [想站多久都行，而且看起来还很可爱！]

rows.source: [LOOK S-S... WHAT?! YOU KNOW WHAT, YIFFAI OUT!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [看起来 S、S……什么？！算了，伊吠通话完毕！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OH MAN WHAT IS THAT?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [天哪，那是什么？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [WHAT DO YOU MEAN? IT'S JUST SOME MILK THAT I BOUGHT.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [你什么意思？就是我买的一些牛奶。]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [I USED TO WORK AT A DAIRY FARM, AND THAT IS NOOOT MILK.]
rows.current: Mauser: [我以前在奶牛场干过，那可绝——对不是牛奶。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [IT IS KINDA JIGGLY. IS MILK USUALLY JIGGLY?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [它还有点颤。牛奶一般也这样吗？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [UHHHHHH]
rows.current: Tomcat: [呃……]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [UMMMMMM]
rows.current: Mauser: [嗯……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IT DOESN'T SEEM TO BE OUTRIGHT POISON, IN ANY CASE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [不管怎样，看着倒不像什么毒物，说不定还真对你有好处！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [SO MAYBE IT'LL ACTUALLY BE GOOD FOR YOU!]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [FISH IS GOOD FOR YOU RIGHT? AND THIS SMELLS LIKE FISH!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [鱼对人有好处吧？而这东西闻着像鱼！]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [OKAY I'M OUT.]
rows.current: Mauser: [好，我撤了。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [ME TOO. GOOD LUCK WITH THAT.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [我也是。你自求多福吧。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OH MAN WHAT IS THAT?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哦天，那是什么？]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [THE SELLER CLAIMED IT WAS MILK...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [卖家声称那是奶……]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [I USED TO WORK AT A DAIRY FARM, AND THAT IS NOOOT MILK.]
rows.current: Mauser: [我以前在奶牛场工作，那绝——不是奶。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [IT IS KINDA JIGGLY. MAYBE IT'S TURNING INTO CHEESE?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [有点晃。也许正在变成奶酪？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IT DOESN'T SEEM TO BE OUTRIGHT POISON, IN ANY CASE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [反正看起来不是直接的毒药，所以也许对你真有好处！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [SO MAYBE IT'LL ACTUALLY BE GOOD FOR YOU!]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [OH YOU'LL LIKE THIS, TOMCAT!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [哦，这个你会喜欢的，雄猫！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OH REALLY, GRRRL?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哦，是吗，丫头？]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [YEAH, IT SMELLS LIKE FISH! YOU LIKE FISH!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [对，闻起来像鱼！你喜欢鱼！]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [OKAY I'M OUT.]
rows.current: Mauser: [好，我撤了。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YEAH I CAN'T TAKE THIS ANYMORE... URP]
rows.current: Tomcat: [是啊，我受不了了……呃]

rows.source: [PSH, IS THAT AN ICE SODA YOU'VE GOT?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [切，你拿的是冰汽水吗？]

rows.source: [EH, THE SHOPKEEPER WAS ENTHUSIASTIC ABOUT IT, AND]
rows.current: Yiffany: [呃，店主对它可热情了，而且我觉得能帮我对付矿井里的热。]

rows.source: [I FIGURED IT WOULD HELP BEAT THE HEAT IN THE MINES]
[I MEAN, IT COULDN'T HURT, RIGHT?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [我是说，反正也不会有什么坏处，对吧？]

rows.source: [JUST DON'T RUN INTO LAVA AFTER CHUGGING IT...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [只是灌下去之后别往熔岩里跑……]

rows.source: [NOW THIS BRINGS BACK MEMORIES.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [这可勾起回忆了。]

rows.source: [LOOKATHAT. AN OLD JUDO GI!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [瞧这个。一件旧柔道服！]

rows.source: [IT ALWAYS MADE ME FEEL LIKE A FIGHTER WHEN I WORE MINE]
rows.current: Yiffany: [以前我穿着自己那套柔道服，随随便便在学院里走动，]

rows.source: [JUST CASUALLY AROUND THE ACADEMY.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [都觉得自己像个格斗家。]

rows.source: [MAYBE THAT'S WHY YOU KEPT GET'N INTO FIGHTS ALL THE TIME]
rows.current: Tomcat: [也许这就是你老是打起来的原因]

rows.source: [JUST DON'T FORGET THAT YOU HAVE A LIGHTTAZER ON YOU]
rows.current: Tomcat: [别忘了你身上有光电击枪]

rows.source: [NO REASON TO DRESS UP AND GO BAREHANDED DOWN THERE.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [没必要穿成这样赤手下场。]

rows.source: [EVEN IF IT MAKES YOU FEEL LIKE A FIGHTER AGAIN!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [就算它又让你觉得自己是个格斗家也一样！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT'S A NEAT HEADBAND YOU GOT THERE!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你这头带挺不错嘛！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [YOU MEAN THIS PIECE OF CLOTH I PICKED UP?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [你说我捡的这块布？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YEAH, YOU DON'T SEE THOSE MUCH OUTSIDE OF TRANING AT]
rows.current: Tomcat: [对，除了学院训练时，平时很少见。不过它能帮你在徒手搏斗时集中精神！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THE ACADEMY, BUT THEY'RE GOOD FOR KEEPING YOUR FOCUS]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WHILE IN UNARMED COMBAT!]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [I DO FEEL A LITTLE STRONGER, NOW THAT YOU MENTION IT!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [你这么一说，我确实感觉力气大了点！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [HEY! A HEADBAND! JUST WHAT I NEEDED]
rows.current: Yiffany: [嘿！头带！正是我需要的]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OH THAT'S GOOD! HERE, I'LL LOOK UP SOME DIRECTIONS ON]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哦，那好！来，我查查怎么把头带改成遮裆布的说明。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [HOW TO TURN THAT INTO A LOINCLOTH.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [NO WAY. DO YOU HAVE ANY IDEA HOW DISRES- PECTFUL THAT IS]
rows.current: Yiffany: [不行。你知道这对把它穿上战场的那名战士有多不敬吗？]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [TO THE FIGHTER THAT WORE THIS INTO THE FIELD?]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OH SORRY, I DIDN'T MEAN TO DISRE-]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哦抱歉，我不是有意不敬-]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.current: Tomcat: [……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [TEEHEE...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [嘻嘻……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [I SHOULD'VE KNOWN BETTER.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [我早该知道。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [ANY EXCUSE TO STAY BOTTOMLESS. SHAMELESS!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [什么借口都要光着下半身。不害臊！]

rows.source: [NOT SURE WHO WOULD LEAVE AROUND SOMETHING LIKE THAT]
rows.current: Tomcat: [不知道谁会把那种东西随手丢着，]

rows.source: [CONSIDERING THAT SCALE SUITS CAN COST THOUSANDS OF LECT]
rows.current: Tomcat: [毕竟一套鳞装可能要花上几千Lect，]

rows.source: [BUT IF YOU'RE COMFORTABLE PUTTING IT ON, GO FOR IT!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [不过你要是穿着舒服，那就穿吧！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT'S A MAP DISK THAT YOU JUST PICKED UP THERE!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你刚捡到的是地图磁盘！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OTHER AGENTS HAVE MAPPED OUT VARIOUS PARTS OF THE AREA]
rows.current: Tomcat: [其他特工绘制了你当前所在区域各部分的地图，有时还带标注。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WE HAVE NO INFO ON COFFEE BEANS BEING GROWN ON TUTONE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [我们没有图托恩种植咖啡豆的资料，这让我瞬间就对这个度假目的地说了个“不”……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WHICH MAKES IT AN INSTANT "NO" FOR MY VACATION...]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BUT HEY! NOTHING WILL PERK UP THE MIND BETTER! ENJOY!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [不过嘿！没有什么比这更能提神了！享用吧！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT'S SOME FINELY STEEPED TEA LEAVES YOU GOT THERE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你这茶叶泡得挺讲究]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IT'LL SOOTHE YOUR NERVES AND CLEAR YOUR MIND REAL GOOD]
rows.current: Tomcat: [能舒缓神经，让头脑特别清醒，所以一定要细细品味！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [SO BE SURE TO SAVOR IT!]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [W-WHAT GIVES? HEY TOMCAT I JUST PICKED UP A ROCK THAT...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [怎、怎么回事？喂雄猫，我刚捡了块石头……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [...THAT SORT OF DISSOLVED WHEN YOU TOUCHED IT?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [……你一碰，它就像融化了一样？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [YEAH! HOW'D YOU KNOW?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [对啊！你怎么知道？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT WAS A PSY CRYSTAL, PUP. SUPPOSEDLY]
rows.current: Tomcat: [那是精神力水晶，小狗。据说这颗星球上的超能力者很重视它们。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THEY WERE HIGHLY VALUED BY THE PLANET'S ESPERS.]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [INHABITANTS OF THE PLANET CLAIMED THAT THEY WILL HEIGHTEN]
rows.current: Tomcat: [星球上的居民说，它们能增强发现者潜在的灵能，不过我们没法测出真假。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THE FINDER'S LATENT PSYCHIC POWERS]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BUT WE DON'T HAVE ANY WAY TO MEASURE IF THAT'S TRUE.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [YOU MEAN THAT ROCK COULD BE MAKING ME A STRONGER PSYCHIC?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [你是说，那石头能增强我的灵能？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [UHHUH! JUST, PLEASE...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [没错！不过，拜托……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [...DON'T TRY EATING THEM? THEY AREN'T CANDY, I SWEAR.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [……别拿来吃，好吗？我发誓那不是糖。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [A-AHH...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [啊、啊……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT'S JUST A ROCK. WHAT ARE YOU ASKING ME ABOUT IT FOR?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [那就是块石头。你问我干嘛？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [SO, I JUST GOT THIS SHIP PART...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [那么，我刚拿到了这个船件……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [I SAW! HEAVY EQUIPMENT ISN'T MY SPECIALTY, BUT]
rows.current: Tomcat: [我看到了！重型设备不是我的专长，但是我们在旧机库请了一位当地机械师，他可以给你进一步的建议。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WE'VE CONTRACTED A LOCAL MECHANIC AT THE OLD HANGAR WHO]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [CAN ADVISE YOU FURTHER.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [GOT IT. I'LL ASK THE MECHANIC.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [明白了。我会去问那位机械师。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YOU FOUND YOUR ID! THAT SHOULD HELP YOU ACCESS]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你找到证件了！这下应该能使用那些老式3P设备，比如点对点传送台。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OLD 3P TECH LIKE THOSE SITE-TO-SITE TELEPADS.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [YEAH, WHAT A RELIEF. I'D HATE TO HAVE LOST IT.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [是啊，松了口气。弄丢了我得心疼死。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [BACK HOME, I GET CARDED *EVERYWHERE*!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [在老家，我*走到哪儿*都要查证件！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [REALLY? *SNRK* I'D NEVER HAVE GUESSED...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [是吗？*噗嗤*真是一点都看不出来……]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [IT'S NOT LIKE I LOOK LIKE A KID OR ANYTHING, RIGHT?!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [我又不长得像个小孩，对吧？！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OF COURSE NOT, HAHA!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [当然不像，哈哈！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [GOT YOUR ID! FINALLY, YOU'RE A BIG GIRL AGAIN!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [拿到你的证件了！你终于又是大姑娘了！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [CAN'T REALLY HAVE A NIGHT ON THE TOWN AROUND HERE, BUT AT]
rows.current: Yiffany: [这附近没法好好进城玩一夜，不过至少我能用这些点对点传送台了。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [LEAST I CAN ACCESS THESE SITE-TO-SITE TELEPADS.]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [HEH, I REMEMBER THAT FAKE ID YOU GOT BACK IN SCHOOL.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [呵，我还记得你上学时弄的那张假证。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [UGH, THAT THING *NEVER* WORKED. SUCH A WASTE OF LECT...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [呃，那东西*从来*就没管用过。纯属浪费 LECT……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [REALLY?! I REMEMBER YOU BRAGGING ABOUT ALL THE THINGS]
rows.current: Tomcat: [真的？！我记得你吹过，用它能买到多少东西！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YOU COULD BUY WITH IT!]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [HEY, I HAD TO GET *SOME* USE OUT OF IT, EVEN IF IT]
rows.current: Yiffany: [嘿，我也得让它*有点*用处，哪怕只是拿来让你们佩服……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [WAS JUST IMPRESSING YOU GUYS...]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [PFT, YOU ALWAYS DID TRY AND ACT COOL.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [噗，你一直都想装酷。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [YEAH YEAH. WE CAN HAVE SOME DRINKS FOR REAL WHEN]
rows.current: Yiffany: [是是。等我回去，我们可以真的喝一杯。伊吠妮完毕。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [I GET BACK. YIFFANY OUT.]
[GOT YOUR ID! FINALLY, YOU'RE A BIG GIRL AGAIN!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [拿到你的证件了！你终于又是大姑娘了！]

rows.source: [CAN'T REALLY HAVE A NIGHT ON THE TOWN AROUND HERE, BUT AT]
rows.current: Yiffany: [这附近没法好好进城玩一夜，不过至少我能用这些点对点传送台了。]

rows.source: [LEAST I CAN ACCESS THESE SITE-TO-SITE TELEPADS.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [HEY TOMCAT, SCAN THIS CRYSTAL THE BREEDER GAVE ME?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [嘿，雄猫，扫描一下育种者给我的这块水晶？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [LOOKS LIKE IT'S A JAKOV'S OBSCURA CRYSTAL.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [看起来是一枚雅科夫的Obscura水晶。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [TECHNICALLY, A FIELD ATTENUATED PRISM. IF YOU'VE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [严格说，是场衰减棱镜。要是你有一只很喜欢你的生物，就可以抚摸它们，给水晶充能！它产生的效果因生物而异！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [GOT A CREATURE WHO LIKES YOU A LOT, YOU CAN PET THEM TO]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [CHARGE UP YOUR CRYSTAL WITH POWER! THE EFFECT IT HAS]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [VARIES PER CREATURE!]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [HUH, GUESS I SHOULD GET SWEET ON ALL THE CREATURES]
rows.current: Yiffany: [唔，要是想有很多能力可选，看来我该对所有生物都甜一点……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [IF I WANT A LOT OF POWERS TO CHOOSE FROM...]
[HEY TOMCAT, SCAN THIS CRYSTAL THE BREEDER GAVE ME?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [嘿，雄猫，帮我扫描育种者给我的这枚水晶？]

rows.source: [LOOKS LIKE IT'S A JAKOV'S OBSCURA CRYSTAL.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [看起来是一枚雅科夫的Obscura水晶。]

rows.source: [TECHNICALLY, A FIELD ATTENUATED PRISM. IF YOU'VE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [严格说，是场衰减棱镜。如果你有一只很喜欢你的生物，可以抚摸它来给你的水晶充上力量！它产生的效果因生物而异！]

rows.source: [GOT A CREATURE WHO LIKES YOU A LOT, YOU CAN PET THEM TO]
[CHARGE UP YOUR CRYSTAL WITH POWER! THE EFFECT IT HAS]
[VARIES PER CREATURE!]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT'S *NOT* A STANDARD RADIO YOU'RE USING, PUP!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [小狗，你用的可*不是*标准收音机！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [OH, IS THERE A PROBLEM WITH IT?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [哦，它有什么问题吗？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [NO THE SIGNAL IS FINE AND ALL. AND IT LOOKS LIKE IT HAS]
rows.current: Tomcat: [不，信号什么的都没问题。而且看样子还装了先进传感器，能帮你执行任务！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [ADVANCED SENSORS INSTALLED THAT WILL HELP YOUR MISSION!]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [THAT'S WHAT THE MOON-DOG-SHOPKEEPER SAID!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [那个月犬店主也是这么说的！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IN ORDER TO USE A KEYCARD, ALL YOU HAVE TO DO IS]
rows.current: Tomcat: [要用门卡的话，你只要拿着一张走进能量门就行。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WALK INTO AN ENERGY DOOR WHILE HOLDING ONE.]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YOU CAN OPEN DOORS UP TO THE LEVEL DISPLAYED ON THEM!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [这张门卡能开启同等级或更低等级的门！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IN ORDER TO USE A KEYCARD, ALL YOU HAVE TO DO IS]
rows.current: Tomcat: [要使用门卡，只需要带着卡走向能量门就行。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WALK INTO AN ENERGY DOOR WHILE HOLDING ONE.]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YOU CAN OPEN DOORS UP TO THE LEVEL DISPLAYED ON THEM!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [可打开等级不高于门上所标数字的门！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IT SEEMS THAT NECKLACE YOU JUST... ACQUIRED WILL ALLOW]
rows.current: Tomcat: [看来你刚……弄到的项链能让你听懂Fenfen语。你也许想复查任何你已记录过的Fenfen记述。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YOU TO UNDERSTAND THE FENFEN LANGUAGE. YOU MIGHT WANNA]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [REVIEW ANY FENFEN ACCOUNTS YOU'VE ALREADY LOGGED.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [GOT IT. YIFFAI OUT.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [收到，伊吠通话完毕。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [NICE GOING, YOU COMPLETED THE POWERMARK!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [干得漂亮，你集齐力量印记了！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [NOW YOU CAN CHARGE YOUR ATTACKS TO THE MAXIMUM!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [现在你能把攻击蓄力到最大了！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [LET'S TRY IT OUT THEN!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [那就试试看！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [HEY BABE! NICE TO KNOW YOU HAVEN'T FORGOTTEN ME! <3]
rows.current: Tomcat: [嘿，宝贝！知道你还没忘了我，真开心！<3]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [I HEAR IF YOU BEAT THIS DEMO QUICKLY, YOU'LL GET]
rows.current: Tomcat: [听说只要你够快通关这个试玩版，就能得到好东西！嘿！嘿！嘿！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [SOMETHING NICE! HE! HE! HE!]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OH WOW, YOUR BODY TEMPERATURE JUST SKYROCKETED, GIRL!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哦哇，你的体温刚飙上去了，姑娘！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WHAT'D YOU SEE, A NETHERHOUND OR MAYBE A KOBOLD OR-]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你看到什么了，冥犬，还是科博德，或者——]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [N-NOTHING LIKE THAT. I JUST PICKED UP A GLOWING ORB OF]
rows.current: Yiffany: [不、不是那种。我只是捡到一颗不知是什么的发光球体。它在我身上留下了某种印记……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [SOME SORT. IT LEFT SOME KIND OF MARK ON ME...]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [HEEEEY, THAT MIGHT BE SOMETHING TO DO WITH THE ESPERS.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [嘿————，那也许和超能力者有关。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [ESPERS? PEOPLE WITH EXTRASENSORY PERCEPTION?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [超能力者？就是有超感官知觉的人？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YEAH, SOME OF THE AGENTS BEFORE YOU MENTIONED THAT]
rows.current: Tomcat: [对，你之前的一些特工提到过，有超感官能力的存在曾经住在那颗星球上。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BEINGS WITH ESP POWERS ONCE LIVED ON THAT PLANET.]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [MAYBE THEY LEFT BEHIND SOME OF THEIR TECHNOLOGY?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [也许他们留下了一些技术？]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [NOW THAT YOU MENTION IT, I DO FEEL STRONGER...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [你这么一说，我确实觉得更强了……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IF YOU FIND ANY MORE ARTIFACTS, GIVE ME A HOLLER]
rows.current: Tomcat: [要是再找到什么造物，喊我一声，我们可以一起试着解开这个谜！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AND WE CAN TRY SOLVE THIS MYSTERY TOGETHER!]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [RIGHT, YIFFANY OUT!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [好，伊吠妮完毕！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [HAVE YOU BEEN EQUIPPED WITH SHOES LIKE THAT BEFORE?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你以前配过这样的鞋吗？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [YEAH! IT WAS BACK AT THE ACADEMY AND IT WAS AWESOME!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [有啊！在学院时用过，超棒的！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [I'M TOTALLY PUMPED TO PRESS "DOWN" + "JUMP" IN THE AIR]
rows.current: Yiffai: [我已经等不及在空中按“DOWN”+“JUMP”，再踩着东西弹跳了！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [AND BOUNCE ON THINGS AGAIN!]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT'S THE SPIRIT, PUP! BOUNCE-BOUNCE ON EVERYTHING!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [这就对了，小狗！见什么都蹦上去！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [BOUNCE FOREVER!!!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [一直蹦下去！！！]

rows.source: [HAVE YOU BEEN EQUIPPED WITH SHOES LIKE THAT BEFORE?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你以前装备过这样的鞋吗？]

rows.source: [ACTUALLY, NO. BUT I READ THE FIELD GUIDE ON THEM ONCE.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [其实没有。不过我以前读过一次它们的野外使用指南。]

rows.source: [PRESS "DOWN"+"JUMP" WHILE IN THE AIR TO DIVE. IF YOU HIT]
rows.current: Tomcat:  [在空中按"下"+"跳跃"就能俯冲。如果你撞到什么东西，就会弹起来。甚至还能连续弹跳！]

rows.source: [SOMETHING, YOU'LL BOUNCE. YOU CAN EVEN BOUNCE REPEATEDLY!]
[WELL I'll LEAVE THE ACROBATICS TO YOU, BUT THIS MIGHT HELP]
rows.current: Yiffany: [好吧，杂技还是留给你吧，不过这也许能帮我摆脱一两个困境……]

rows.source: [ME OUT OF A TIGHT SPOT OR TWO...]
[IT'S SUCH FUN THOUGH. BOUNCE BOUNCE, MEOW!!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [可是真的很好玩啊。弹啊弹，喵！！]

rows.source: [TH- THANKS TOMCAT. OVER.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [谢、谢谢你，雄猫。完毕。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT FLASHLIGHT - OR TORCH, AS BOSSU CALLS IT - WILL]
rows.current: Tomcat: [那把手电筒——波苏管它叫火把——会自动照亮昏暗的地方。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [ILLUMINATE LOW-LIGHT AREAS AUTOMATICALLY.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [I DON'T HAVE TO DO ANYTHING SPECIAL TO USE IT, RIGHT?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [用它不需要特别操作，对吧？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAAT'S RIGHT, JUST LEAVE IT ON AND LET IT WORK ITS MAGIC!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [没——错，开着就行，它自己会发挥作用！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WHAT'S THAT YOU'VE GOT, KIDDO? YOUR SISTER'S WHISTLE?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [小家伙，拿着什么呢？你姐姐的哨子？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [OUR DAD'S WHISTLE, ACTUALLY. YIFFANY GAVE IT TO ME]
rows.current: Yiffai: [其实是我们爸爸的哨子。伊吠妮恢复神志之后给我的。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [AFTER SHE CAME TO HER SENSES.]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OHHH, SO IT'S SOME KIND OF FAMILY HEIRLOOM?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哦——原来算是传家宝？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [YEAH. I STILL REMEMBER THE DAY YIFFANY WENT OFF TO]
rows.current: Yiffai: [是啊。我还记得伊吠妮出发去学院的那天，爸爸把这个给了她……]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [THE ACADEMY AND DAD GAVE HER THIS...]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [SHE SAID SHE'D LET ME HOLD IT ON MY FIRST REAL MISSION.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [她说等我第一次正式出任务，就让我拿着。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [I GUESS SHE KEPT HER PROMISE AFTER ALL...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [看来她还真守了诺言……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [HEH, THAT'S CUTE. WELL, GIVE IT A BLOW IF YOU NEED A LIFT.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [呵，真温馨。想搭便车就吹一下。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YOUR SISTER IS SURE TO HEAR IT, ALMOST ANYWHERE!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [不管在哪儿，你姐姐几乎都能听见！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WHAT'S THAT YOU'VE GOT THERE? YOUR OLD WHISTLE?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你拿的那是什么？你那只旧哨子？]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [YEAH. IT'S A SORT OF FAMILY GOOD LUCK CHARM.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [对。算是家里传下来的护身符吧。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [I PASSED IT ON TO YIFFAI FOR HIS FIRST FIELD MISSION...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [伊吠第一次出外勤时，我把它传给了他……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [BUT HE GAVE IT BACK A MOMENT AGO, AFTER I KNOCKED THE]
rows.current: Yiffany: [可他刚才又还给了我，就在我把他身上的'星杀'打出来之后……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: ['STARKILL' OUT OF HIM...]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AWW, THAT'S SWEET. WELL, GIVE IT A BLOW IF YOU NEED A LIFT.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哎呀，真暖心。好啦，需要搭个便车就吹一声吧。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YOUR BROTHER IS SURE TO HEAR IT, ALMOST ANYWHERE!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你弟弟几乎在任何地方都准能听见！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THOSE BERRIES ARE SO JUICY AND PLUMP...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [那些浆果可真是饱满多汁……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IT'S ALMOST LIKE THEY'RE ASKING TO BE POPPED!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [简直是在求你把它们破开嘛！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [I BET IT'LL MAKE YOU FEEL LIKE YOU JUST GOT LUCKIER]
rows.current: Tomcat: [我敢说，吃一颗之后，你也会觉得自己更走运了！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AFTER YOU EAT ONE, TOO!]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [GREAT NEWS, JUST GOT A HARDNUT! HOW ARE THE SENSORS?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [好消息，刚搞到个硬坚果！传感器怎么说？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YOU DID NOT, THERE'S NO CHANGE IN YOUR TEMP OR TO Y-]
rows.current: Tomcat: [才没有，你的体温没变，你的——]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OH HAR HAR, FOUND SOME OF THE LOCAL EDIBLE DELIGHTS EH.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哦，哈哈，原来是找到当地的美味了啊。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AT LEAST BE SERIOUS FOR A MOMENT AND LET ME TELL YOU THAT]
rows.current: Tomcat: [至少先认真一会儿，听我说，那些坚果能增强你的防御能力。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THOSE NUTS WILL RAISE YOUR DEFENSIVE CAPABILITIES.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [HAHA! UPSET THAT YOU DIDN'T MAKE THE JOKE FIRST, HUH.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [哈哈！没抢先讲出这个笑话，不爽了吧。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [N-NO. IT'S NOT LIKE I'VE BEEN STUDYING UP ON THE FLORA]
rows.current: Tomcat: [才、才没有。我可没为了说些蠢双关什么的，就特意研究这里的植物和动物……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AND FAUNA JUST TO MAKE STUPID PUNS OR ANYTHING...]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.current: Tomcat: [……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [*PAPERS RUSTLE IN THE BACKGROUND*]
rows.current: Tomcat: [*背景传来纸张沙沙声*]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BUT LET ME KNOW IF YOU FIND ANYTHING ELSE. TOMCAT OUT!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [不过找到别的东西也记得告诉我。雄猫通话完毕！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [DUDE.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [老兄。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OCTOPUS.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [章鱼。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [I LOVE OCTOPUS.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [我爱章鱼。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [DUDE. BRO. GIMME.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [老兄。兄弟。给我。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IT MAKES YOU SMARTER TOO, I NEED IT.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [它也能让你更聪明，我需要它。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [D U D E . . .]
rows.current: Tomcat: [老——兄……]

rows.source: [DUDE.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [老兄。]

rows.source: [OCTOPUS.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [章鱼。]

rows.source: [I LOVE OCTOPUS.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [我爱章鱼。]

rows.source: [DUDE. BRO. GIMME.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [老兄。兄弟。给我。]

rows.source: [IT MAKES YOU SMARTER TOO, I NEED IT.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [它也能让你更聪明，我需要它。]

rows.source: [D U D E . . .]
rows.current: Tomcat: [兄 弟 ……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT'S ONE FIERY CHILI PEPPER YOU GOT THERE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你手上拿的可是一颗火辣辣椒]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AS LONG AS YOU DON'T MIND SOMETHING SPICY]
rows.current: Tomcat: [只要吃得了辣，它应该能帮你恢复不少！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT SHOULD HEAL YOU UP REAL GOOD!]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [...ALMOST MAKES IT WORTH FIGHTING THOSE BRUTES!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [……有这收获，跟那些蛮横家伙打一架几乎都算值得了！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [ALRIGHT, WHAT NONSENSE IS THIS NOW...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [好吧，这次又是什么鬼东西……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT'S NOT SOMETHING YOU COME ACROSS EVERY DAY...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [这东西可不是天天都能见到的……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YOU SURE THAT'S SAFE TO HANDLE, GRRRL?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你确定拿着它没事，丫头？]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [I DUNNO, YOU TELL ME. I'M FEELING FINE SO FAR!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [不知道啊，得问你。我目前感觉挺好！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT LOOKS LIKE SOME SORT OF BLACK MARKET BIOCRYPTO]
rows.current: Tomcat: [看着像某种黑市生物加密货币，里面……还装着个“USL”应用？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WITH... A "USL" APP ONBOARD?]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [USWHAT NOW?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [US什么玩意儿？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OH THAT'S RIGHT, YOU BARELY PASSED P.A.W. USE CLASSES]
